The BM3 reference cell is from Meng et al., Physics and Chemistry of Minerals 21, 407-413 (1994), doi:10.1007/BF00203299. Fractional coordinates and the experimentally refined partial Mg-Si disorder are from Sasaki et al., Journal of Geophysical Research 87, 7829-7832 (1982), doi:10.1029/JB087iB09p07829, COD 1549722 (origin choice used by that CIF). Phase-line intensities were calculated from the cited structure using independent-atom X-ray form factors.
